items.title: Layer-first map editor workflow is reachable
items.precondition: Dev server is running at http://127.0.0.1:1616 and the smoke test signs in as the seeded admin user.
steps: 3. Assert the workflow exposes Base Map, Site Plan, Blocks, Lots, Tiers, and Review.
items.expected: The map editor renders a canvas and each layer mode is available from the workflow controls.

items.title: Base map and site-plan controls are visible from the layer workflow
items.precondition: Same browser smoke session as T1.
steps: 1. In the smoke test, inspect Base Map mode.
3. Assert satellite/default/reset controls plus site-plan upload, compare, opacity, and lock controls when an overlay exists.
items.expected: Base map controls are view-only, and the site-plan overlay controls are reachable without opening Advanced Inventory.

items.title: Rectangle block, lot, and overlay transforms preserve inventory identity
items.precondition: Focused QA runs against local TypeScript source through vite-node.
steps: 2. Assert block move/resize/rotate updates block geometry.
3. Assert lot footprints remain tier-sized and sold-lot business fields are preserved.
4. Assert overlay move/resize/rotate changes only overlay draft geometry.
items.expected: Geometry changes are visual and draft-only, with lot identity/status/client/contract data unchanged.

items.title: Exact lot count and tier footprint rules are enforced
items.precondition: Focused QA uses the same grid and geometry helpers consumed by the map editor.
steps: 2. Assert a rows-by-columns grid can be capped by exactCount.
3. Assert tier mismatch blocks publish and resizing to tier widthM/lengthM resolves the mismatch.
items.expected: Generated placeholder count honors exact count, and tier dimensions remain the lot footprint source of truth.

items.title: Invalid geometry blocks Publish and is visible in review
items.precondition: Browser smoke and focused QA have access to seeded map-editor data.
steps: 3. Run npx vite-node qa/map-editor-alignment.ts for overlap, outside-block, and tier-footprint conflict assertions.
items.expected: Review either reports no blockers or explains publish blocking, while focused QA proves invalid layouts cannot publish.
items.evidence: node qa/map-editor-layered-smoke.mjs -> map-editor-layered-smoke-ok; npx vite-node qa/map-editor-alignment.ts -> map-editor-alignment-ok

items.title: Repository verification suite passes
items.expected: Typecheck, build, lint, and mock validation all exit 0.
items.evidence: tsc exit 0; build exit 0; lint exit 0 with existing warnings; validate:mock exit 0
items.notes: Lint still reports existing warnings in unrelated files, including fast-refresh and unused-variable warnings.
